_note: Seeded CRM for the demo (spec §22). Everything here is fictional: no real people,
no real companies, no real addresses.
Records reference each other by `key`, not by id. The seed script derives a stable
UUID from each key (lib/ids.ts deterministicId), so `npm run reset` restores the
exact same state including ids, while this file stays readable and cannot contain a
SPEC RECONCILIATION — spec §22 said the seeded near-duplicate pair was 'Acme Commerce'
and 'ACME Consulting', but E-01 (the hero lead) requires Acme Commerce to be a NEW
company with no CRM match. Those two cannot both be true. The near-duplicate pair is
therefore Harborview Digital / Harborview Media, and Acme Commerce is deliberately
absent so E-01 stays a genuine new-lead case. E-04's sender address must be chosen in
M1 to match neither Harborview domain exactly (e.g. @harborview-group.com), so that
entity resolution produces a real conflict rather than a staged one.
